The sign is public property? It's a village sign, likely a public property (public or collective). The act is intentional destruction of public or private property. The amount is 10,713 RMB, which is considered "relatively large" (数额较大). The charge likely is "故意毁坏公私财物罪" (intentional damage to public or private property). So final answer.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "敲诈勒索"? No, he demanded compensation but didn't extort. He just destroyed sign. So single crime.
